cause_and_competing_causes.supported_cause: transposition is equivariant for relation membership, but exact row interaction depends on a separate suffix/prefix language overlap

mathematical: bounded cause, scope, falsifier, repair condition

falsifier: Exhibit a pair violating complement-transpose membership, a high cross row not generated by an UNSAT suffix, or a collision not corresponding exactly to H intersection P; any such witness refutes the relevant part.

obligations.proof: For any (a,b) in D: (a,b) in G^T iff (a,b) notin tau(U) iff (b,a) notin U iff (b,a) in G. Thus G^T=tau(G).

The C041 reduction maps encoded x=r||c to q=(r,M+c), with x SAT iff q in G. Applying tau gives q^T=(M+c,r), and proof 1 gives q in G iff q^T in G^T. Therefore x SAT iff (M+c,r) in G^T. Retaining q rather than swapping both endpoints is not justified.
obligations.scope: exact transposed family and swapped reduction

obligations.proof: The original decoded complement cross points are exactly (r,M+c) for UNSAT Dec(r||c). Their transposes are exactly (M+c,r). Hence a high row M+c occurs iff some r makes Dec(r||c) canonical UNSAT, i.e. c in S_k. Its binary label is 1||bin_k(c).
obligations.scope: decoded cross block only; inherited rows are separate

obligations.proof: By proof 3 the literal-transpose high-row language is H={1||bin_k(c):c in S_k}. By definition P_(k+1) is the current canonical prefix language. Exact row collision is existence of a label in both sets, hence exactly H intersection P_(k+1) nonempty. This is equivalence, not an existence claim.
obligations.scope: exact label equality; no level selected

obligations.proof: Proof 2 uses only relation equivariance under tau and says nothing about H intersection P. Proof 4 uses only row-label sets and says nothing about SAT equivalence of the query map. Therefore neither derivation supplies the other obligation. A viable repair for the intended route requires both; collision with an unswapped/incorrect reduction or faithful transpose with empty overlap fails the conjunction.
obligations.scope: logical independence of these proof obligations, not probabilistic independence

proof_common.derivation: tau is a bijection of D, so D\tau(U)=tau(D\U); hence G^T=tau(G).

repair_condition: To advance beyond this transfer lemma, prove H intersection P nonempty under a separately frozen target-blind construction; do not count high-half occupancy or the transpose identity as collision evidence.
scope: exact C041 decoder/equal split/full recursive transpose
all k>=2 for identities and equivalences
